notes:
v4.6.26 — Initial portfolio cleanup + AI output syntax validation

✨ NEW
• Every bot now liquidates inherited positions that don't match its asset_type at startup. A crypto bot taking over an account that previously ran a stock bot will close ALL stock positions deterministically before placing any trade — no AI needed for asset-class mismatch. A stocks bot finding crypto positions does the same.
• Lives in core.bot_framework.liquidate_off_strategy_positions(client, asset_type). Auto-called by BotRunner.run() so every Make Bot framework bot gets it for free. Also wired into longbot_v2, shortbot_v2, daybot, and the CRYPTO trader template — no bot is exempt.
• Complements the v4.6.2 AI transition cleanup which handles the subtler long-vs-short reorganisation within the same asset class via the bot's own philosophy.

🐛 FIXED
• Make Bot generated bots with unterminated triple-quotes / mid-function truncation now caught BEFORE the broken code reaches your disk. _GenerateWorker runs compile(code, '<bot>', 'exec') on the AI output and surfaces 'AI output has a Python syntax error at line N: <msg>' to the user. Saved bots can't crash on launch with SyntaxError anymore.
• Save-to-library button also runs compile() so manual edits in the editor pane get caught before disk write.

Includes v4.6.25's local custom bot launch fix (no more 'Unknown bot' exit).
